title: Acceptance evaluator brief lists a non-holder note as citable evidence without a context-only mark, so a passing verdict is refused for citing it
outcome: Acceptance evaluator brief lists a non-holder note as citable evidence without a context-only mark, so a passing verdict is refused for citing it
acceptance: The failing path is identified with file:line: where the host-prepared evaluator brief assembles its evidence list and why a non-holder / pre-claim observation (not selected by the requester) appears in it without being marked context-only.

A regression: a brief built for an item whose notes include non-holder observations lists only current-run holder notes and gates as citable, and marks every other note it shows as context-only (or omits it); an evaluator following the brief can no longer produce a verdict the tracker refuses for citing ineligible evidence.
The citable set the brief presents agrees with the tracker's submission eligibility rule (the same predicate or a shared definition), proven by a test that feeds both the same item.
